text:
Alyssa: Heads-up — saw a new OOM on paged-attn in prod-replay-2 at 17:02. Symptoms: sudden compaction spike and long stall while coalescing blocks. Logs below.

Jon: Can you paste the allocator snapshot and any kernel-selection state?

Alyssa: ```
ALLOC SNAPSHOT:
free_blocks=128
total_blocks=4096
block_size=64KB
kv_workspace=1.6GB
active_kv=1.12GB
compaction_runs=23
last_compaction_ms=4203
kernel_path=fast_small (fallback_count=7)
batching_profile=burst(80%), steady(20%)
```

Maria: Is this related to the kernel-selection change we rolled last week (prefer_small_blocks=true)? We saw higher workspace pressure in canary but thought compaction would absorb it.

Akash: Likely correlated. My read: the fallback to the slower kernel path causes longer-lived KV windows, which increases block residency and triggers the coalescer heuristics. Quick profiler: 

Akash: ```
PROFILER SAMPLE (hot functions):
block_alloc                42%
block_compaction           28%
kv_prefetch               12%
kernel_swap               10%
other                     8%
median_compact_duration=3.8ms
95th_compact_duration=12.4ms
```

Sam: Ouch. Two paths to mitigate: disable aggressive coalescing temporarily, or reduce min_coalesce_threshold so we prefer reuse over merging. Any microbenchmark data? :eyes:

Jon: I ran a staging toggle earlier — enabling eager_reuse cut compaction_runs 23 -> 3, but increased p95 token-latency by ~12ms on sequences >1024 tokens (likely because we blocked reuse on hot small-block kernel path). Tradeoff.

Alyssa: Crash stack (from coredump): ```
#0  0x7f3a2b1c in BlockManager::compact_blocks(BlockRange)
#1  0x7f3a2c2f in KVWorkspace::evict_for_allocation
#2  0x7f3a3d7a in Allocator::reserve_workspace
#3  0x7f3a4e9b in serve_request_internal
```

perf-bot: :rotating_light: perf-alert: thread=2210001111, service=paged-attn, event=oom_spike, instances=3, p95_latency+18% over 10m.

Maria: Proposal (short-term + medium):
1) short-term: set coalescer_backoff_on_fallback=true and min_coalesce_threshold=2 (lower merge aggressiveness)
2) medium: add compaction_cost_budget per-workspace, skip coalescing when estimated_compact_ms > budget
3) telemetry: emit block_reuse_ratio and compaction_ms histogram per model+kernel for 24h
I'll open a small RFC/PR for the config toggles.

Akash: I can run a microbench: iterate sequence lengths [256,512,1024,2048] with fallback toggled and measure compaction_runs + p95. If compaction_cost_per_eviction > 2ms, prefer reuse over coalesce.

Sam: I'll schedule a canary rollout of the backoff toggle on dedicated-pool-2 at 04:00 PT. Tagging @eng-runtime @eng-ml for watch.

Alyssa: Thanks team. Action items: Maria PR for config, Akash benchmark, Sam canary, Jon follow-up on the kernel-selection flags that increased fallback_count. I'll attach traces to the incident. :thumbsup:
